title: Iridium Network
description: Fun and wholesome community server for you and your friends!
body:
**Welcome to the Iridium Network!**

IridiumNet is a community Minecraft server that hosts events for YouTubers and is currently partnered with Fundy. Originally beginning in 2019 and then rebranding in 2025, we continue to host a fun and unique experience for Minecraft for Java players.

IridiumNet began as a small Discord community Minecraft server where the community was tight-knit and very humble, and that is something which is still around on IridiumNet to this day, our playerbase are extremely welcoming and are always looking for new friends and love embracing new players into the community.

Our moderation team strives for our server to remain as drama-free as possible and are always on hand to help out, be it via email, discord or on the server itself, we will always have someone around to answer your questions and make your journey on IridiumNet be as pleasant as possible.

Features:
- Unique SMP
- Fortnightly Events
- Creative Plots
- Friendly and Wholesome Community!

Server Address- play.iridiummc.net
Discord- [https://discord.iridiummc.net/](https://discord.iridiummc.net/)
